messages:
Maya: heads up — quick-insights for org 842 showed cards from org 19 for ~30s at 10:12 UTC. spotted in customer demo. :grimacing:
Derek: ouch. any logs or query samples?
Maya: pasted the raw request we got from the console: 
```
POST /api/insights/quick HTTP/1.1
Host: console.internal
X-User: maya@redwood.ai
X-Org-Hint: 842
Cookie: affinity=sidecar-5; route_slot=3
Body: {"panel_ids":["top-queries"]}
```
Responses included rows tagged with org_id: 19 — user reported seeing another org's metrics in the sidepanel.
Liam: timeline? did this coincide with a deploy or rollout window?
Maya: 10:11–10:13, small canary was flipped from v3 -> v4 on the insights-sidecar at 10:10 per deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service=insights-sidecar release=v4 at 2025-11-12T10:10:05Z. 20% traffic.
Sophia: possible cache key miss? quick insights results are cached in in-memory LRU keyed by request fingerprint. if `X-Org-Hint` isn't part of the fingerprint it's easy to bleed.
Jordan: we also prefetch panel data in the sidecar to speed up nav. that prefetch path sometimes calls the internal API without `X-Org-Hint` (we attach via header middleware normally). looking at the code :(
Derek: reprod steps? can we force locally?
Maya: yes — repro in staging by toggling canary and then hammering quick-insights for two orgs quickly. I got it to show other org rows ~3/50 attempts. intermittent.
Liam: likely race between prefetch and header enrichment middleware. prefetch uses a short-lived client that skips header middleware for perf. it then writes to the sidecar cache with a key that omits org.
Sophia: suggested quick fix: include `org_id` in cache key and make cache writes opt-in for prefetched responses. less risky than touching middleware on hot path.
Jordan: agree. also add defensive check: responses should always include `org_id` in payload and the sidecar should assert payload.org_id === request.org_hint before serving cached entry. fail closed if mismatch.
Derek: can we ship a canary rollback or patch?
Maya: rolling back the canary now to stop bleed. deploying patch in parallel.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback requested for service=insights-sidecar release=v4 at 2025-11-12T10:14:22Z.
Liam: I'll open a short PR to add org to cache key and assert guard. low-risk, unit tests included.
Sophia: add an e2e that simulates rapid org switch + prefetch to catch this.
Jordan: add telemetry: emit a metric when we detect mismatched org_id served (counter + sample payload id). route it to eng-platform dashboards.
Maya: filing a postmortem ticket after we confirm fix. customer notified proactively. :white_check_mark:
Derek: thanks — next steps assignable?
Liam: I'll own the PR and trace. Jordan will add telemetry. Sophia will add e2e. Maya will own the postmortem and customer comms.
Maya: ping me in #incidents if anything else pops. :eyes:
